summary: Deletes the Account field Legacy_Code__c. The active Flow Account_Sync still writes to it, so the deploy will fail until the Flow is updated.

components.name: Account.Legacy_Code__c
components.reason: Still referenced by the active Flow Account_Sync.

findings.message: Flow Account_Sync assigns Legacy_Code__c, which this PR deletes. Deleting a field an active Flow references fails the deploy.
findings.fix: Remove the Copy_Legacy assignment from Account_Sync (or deactivate the Flow) in this same PR, then delete the field.
